label.purpose: Regular contextual instruction and field labels.

layout.contextControls: Horizontal NSStackView inside NSScrollView; horizontal scrolling, no wrapping

colorSources.accent: NSColor(srgbRed:green:blue:alpha:) component values recorded as CSS rgb percentages
colorSources.checker: NSColor(white:alpha:) component values recorded as neutral RGB percentages

canvas.actualSize: One image pixel per backing pixel
canvas.fit: Never upscales beyond one image pixel per backing pixel

interaction.ocr: Text-region editing locks during detection; other tools remain available
interaction.quit: All document windows lock during confirmation; queued Open events resume on cancellation

native.inheritedStyles: Native surfaces, control colors and typography, disabled states, focus, selection, tabs, rounded bezels, popups, sheets, and progress indicators retain AppKit styling.
native.previewPolicy: No invented HTML/CSS component translations or synthetic tonal ramps. This is a native AppKit interface; system appearance values are semantic API names, not fixed web tokens.

components.name: Tool selector
components.behavior: Text labels, single selection, centered in unified NSToolbar

components.name: Document tabs
components.behavior: Automatic tabbing with native Window menu actions

components.name: Contextual controls
components.behavior: Native buttons, sliders with numeric readouts, fields, checkbox, and color wells

components.name: Image canvas
components.behavior: Custom image drawing, checkerboard, region outlines, and clipped brush preview

components.name: Status strip
components.behavior: Middle truncation, full-text tooltip, spinner, system-red error and Dismiss

components.name: Save format
components.behavior: Visible Format accessory selects export type and filename extension

components.name: Unsaved confirmation
components.behavior: Document sheet with Save copy or Save, Cancel, and Discard

native.visualEvidenceScope: Native light appearance, compact tabs, OCR, save-format and unsaved sheets; dark appearance at 760 × 560 with a settled highlight edit. Captures verified by the implementation agent. No web detector ran and no web/iOS mapping applies.

narrative.overview: Candy is a native macOS image utility in Operate mode: a familiar Preview-like workspace with the image in focus. A native toolbar and contextual controls sit above the canvas; a compact status strip sits below it. Document windows support native macOS tabs and follow the system light or dark appearance.
keyCharacteristics: Native AppKit controls, menus, document windows, and sheets.
System fonts and semantic colors for ordinary interface elements.
Coral outlines for custom image regions.
Visible tool values, document state, progress, and errors.
dos: Do keep the canvas as the main workspace.
Do use native AppKit controls and their system appearance.
Do reserve the custom coral palette for image-region overlays.
Do keep numeric values and units visible beside editing controls.
Do preserve keyboard commands, native tabs, and document-scoped sheets.
donts: Don't add decorative cards or dashboard composition to the editor.
Don't treat colors or typography inside an opened image as Candy interface tokens.
Don't replace system colors, font metrics, control shapes, or focus states with guessed values.
Don't use preview dimensions for edits or exports.
